new_articles.title: LG Energy Solution flags 26% rise in Q3 operating profit
new_articles.summary: LG Energy Solution 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'LG Energy Solution flags 26% rise in Q3 operating profit'이다. Channel NewsAsia is an English-language news organization based in Singapore. SEOUL, Oct 8 : South Korean battery maker LG Energy Solution said on Thursday the company expects its July-September operating profit to rise 25. 7 per cent to 756 billion won ($564. 09 million). That compared with an LSEG SmartEstimate forecast for an operating profit of 309 billion won, which is weighted towar. Click here to return to FAST Tap here to return to FAST FAST SEOUL, Oct 8 : South Korean battery maker LG Energy Solution said on Thursday the company expects its July-September operating profit to rise 25 6 trillion won from a year earlier, according to LGES' regulatory filing • The quarterly earnings guidance includes tax credits provided under the US Inflation Reduction Act for the company's battery production in the United States, LGES said in a statement However, they cautioned that LGES' ESS business remains loss-making and that the timing of a turnaround has been pushed back • LGES said it plans to announce detailed quarterly results on November 3.

new_articles.title: HYBE to host Weverse Con Festival in New Delhi in March 2027
new_articles.summary: HYBE 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'HYBE to host Weverse Con Festival in New Delhi in March 2027'이다. First international edition will feature K-pop and Indian artists, with tickets exclusively on BookMyShow. com/companies/hybe-to-host-weverse-con-festival-in-new-delhi-in-march-2027/article71556896 ece South Korean entertainment giant HYBE will host the first international edition of its Weverse Con Festival in New Delhi on 27–28 March 2027, marking the event’s debut outside South Korea The two-day festival will feature a mixed line-up of K-pop and Indian artists, along with collaborative stages and fan engagement activations tied to HYBE’s Weverse platform HYBE Chief Executive Officer Jason Jaesang Lee described the festival as part of the company’s “multi-home, multi-genre” strategy, with India identified as a priority growth market The announcement comes alongside HYBE’s broader India push through HYBE INDIA, its Mumbai-based strategic office, which has been running nationwide talent auditions and developing locally produced content aimed at global distribution. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
